findings.location: launch_manager generic exception handler — never transitions the task (merged duplicate found independently by Audit 01 and Audit 04)
findings.finding: When launch_manager raises, the handler sets pipeline_state='blocked' and alerts but never calls transition_task(); the task stays in 'coding' (or 'ready_for_review' if failure precedes the coding transition) with no API/UI recovery (restart_task 409s active statuses; only the undocumented manual PATCH works). Exception path also skips preserve_worktree.
findings.evidence: Source audits 01 (ARCH-01-001) and 04 (ORCH-04-101), same file/lines/root cause. Re-verified at 33bbd03c: agents.py:615-620 still has update_pipeline_state + append_log + send_task_alert only, no transition_task.
findings.production_impact: Tasks hitting an unexpected manager exception are orphaned in an active status; manual DB/PATCH intervention required. No data loss.
findings.recommendation: Mirror the planning fix: guarded update_pipeline_state + transition_task(db2, task_id, 'blocked'); call preserve_worktree(task_id) first.
findings.status_at_head: OPEN — accepted known limitation; mitigation: manual PATCH escape hatch (api/tasks.py:231-244) + cancel path

findings.location: simple-mode cost estimates use hardcoded Haiku-era constants (~3.75x understated)
findings.finding: _COST_PER_INPUT_TOKEN=0.0000008 / _COST_PER_OUTPUT_TOKEN=0.000004 vs configured Sonnet-era rates 0.000003/0.000015 — agent_runs.cost_estimate and dashboards understate simple-mode spend ~3.75x. Constants bypass config entirely.
findings.evidence: Source Audit 01 (ARCH-01-002). Re-verified at 33bbd03c: constants still present at agents.py:33-34.
findings.production_impact: Cost reporting/aggregates wrong for simple-mode runs; real spend still bounded by spend_guard pre-call gate + ledger (enforcement independent of these estimates).
findings.status_at_head: OPEN — accepted known limitation; mitigation: spend_guard caps actual spend

findings.location: bhaskar_tool always fails: load_role() raises FileNotFoundError at graph construction
findings.finding: roles/bhaskar_agent.md does not exist; every bhaskar_tool call returns a structured ok=false with zero tokens. Default-enabled (config.py:1802-1805), wired into chat + >=8 agent tool lists; tests monkeypatch run_agent_graph so CI stays green.
findings.evidence: Source Audit 02 (AGENT-02-001), runtime-proved at baseline. Re-verified at 33bbd03c: file still absent (roles/ has 86 files, none matching bhaskar).
findings.production_impact: Advertised on-demand tool synthesis never works; failure is graceful with zero spend.
findings.recommendation: Add the role file (7 standard sections) + regression test asserting load_role() for every role_name= literal in app/.
findings.status_at_head: OPEN — accepted known limitation; mitigation: graceful structured failure, no spend

findings.location: leader-election engine sized from a 16-name tuple while 20 loops are registered — 4 singleton loops permanently dead on every default deployment
findings.line: main.py:1628-1645 (16 names) vs 1665-1792 (20 _run_as_leader registrations); sizing 1341-1343,1647 (pool_size=16, max_overflow=0); connection held for loop lifetime 1374-1398
findings.finding: Four registered loops absent from the tuple: loop:versioned_lesson_consolidation, loop:memory_embeddings_consolidation, loop:agent_historical_performance_rollup, loop:documentation_score_compute. With max_overflow=0, 4 of 20 tasks block on checkout, hit the 30s pool timeout, raise TimeoutError outside any try — permanently dead, no retry, no health check surface.
findings.evidence: Source Audit 04 (ORCH-04-102). Re-verified at 33bbd03c: name-set diff = 20 unique loop names vs 16-name tuple; pool_size=len(_leader_loop_names)=16; max_overflow=0.
findings.production_impact: Four quality-maintenance loops (lesson/embedding consolidation, performance rollup, docs score) silently never run + recurring startup TimeoutError cluster. Memory degrades gracefully; no user-facing operation depends on them.
findings.recommendation: One line: size the engine from a single (lock_name, loop) tuple list, or set max_overflow >= 4 as stopgap. Highest-value fix in the register.
findings.status_at_head: OPEN — accepted known limitation; mitigation: quality-maintenance only; fix is one line

findings.location: cost-approval gate has no working resume path
findings.finding: Epics over COST_APPROVAL_THRESHOLD ($1.00) halt to pending_cost_approval; 'Approve Cost & Start Agents' relaunches the manager which deterministically re-blocks (no cost_approved flag anywhere); the other approve endpoint strands the epic at status 'approved' with no relaunch. No test covers the approve direction.
findings.evidence: Source Audit 09 (PROD-09-101). Verified during Audit 09 at HEAD: grep cost_approved -> 0 hits; unconditional edge chain manager.py:2579-2590.
findings.production_impact: Workflow dead-end for >$1 epics; nothing runs while blocked (spend bounded); operator workaround = raise threshold.
findings.recommendation: Persist approval on the epic and honor it in _cost_estimate_node; add block->approve->planning regression test.
findings.status_at_head: OPEN — accepted known limitation; mitigation: raise COST_APPROVAL_THRESHOLD; spend bounded

Gate condition 2: all High findings either resolved or explicitly accepted as known limitations with documented mitigations (met via the H-1..H-5 acceptance register; two fixes, H-4 and H-1, strongly recommended before scaling beyond a single-operator deployment; ordered pre-scale fix list provided).
